svg.title: ShopLedger architecture
svg.desc: The browser calls Express routers. Order placement reads the store, validates stock and coupons, prices the cart, updates credit and inventory, and writes the order and audit event.

g.text: inventory, pricing, tax, coupons, ledger, orders, dates

svg.text: Place order → check stock → price items → apply Khata debit if needed → deduct stock → save order
Persistence · lib/store.js reads and writes data/db.json, including the order audit log.
config.js supplies shop details, tax slabs and coupon rules. The printable invoice route in server.js uses lib/invoice.js.
